observation.command:
cd /workspace
# Verify we have working binaries
/tmp/minio_server2 --version 2>&1 | head -1
/tmp/mc --version 2>&1 | head -1
# Build dir
mkdir -p /workspace/.minio-build
cp /tmp/minio_server2 /workspace/.minio-build/minio
cp /tmp/mc /workspace/.minio-build/mc
ls -la /workspace/.minio-build/
echo "=== test: does minio server actually serve? ==="
cd /workspace/.minio-build
MINIO_ROOT_USER=admin MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=secretsecret timeout 6 ./minio server /tmp/mtest --address :19000 --console-address :19001 > /tmp/minio-test.log 2>&1 &
MPID=$!
sleep 4
echo "--- health ---"; curl -fsS http://localhost:19000/minio/health/live -o /dev/null -w "live=%{http_code}\n" 2>&1
echo "--- api root ---"; curl -sS http://localhost:19000/minio/health/live -o /dev/null -w "live-body=%{http_code}\n" 2>&1
kill $MPID 2>/dev/null
echo "=== minio test log tail ==="; tail -5 /tmp/minio-test.log
